help: One certificate for {domain} and every *.{domain} subdomain. The domain's DNS must be on this server or on Cloudflare.
confirmOn: Issue a wildcard certificate for {domain} and *.{domain}? A TXT record is added to the domain's DNS while the CA checks it. This can take a few minutes.
confirmOff: Stop covering *.{domain}? {domain} gets a plain certificate, and subdomains without their own certificate lose HTTPS.
